newsitem.title: USA: Worldwide PetroMoly signs lubricant deal.
newsitem.headline: Worldwide PetroMoly signs lubricant deal.

text.p: Worldwide PetroMoly Corp said Tuesday it expected $1 million to $1.5 million in annual revenues from a deal it signed with private High Standard Manufacturing Co to produce firearm lubricant.
"We believe it's minuscule compared to what's coming," said chief financial officer Lance Rosmarin in an interview. He added the company makes a 60 percent profit margin on firearm lubricants.
Wordwide PetroMoly had about $500,000 in sales last year, Rosmarin said. He added High Standard of Houston, a manafucturer of 22 different kinds of target pistols, will market the firearm lubricants.

Rosmarin said the company has tested its lubricant oils with several companies, including Continental Airlines Inc, Enron Corp and Greyhound Lines Inc. He added Worldwide PetroMoly is close to a deal with Continental.
"Sales are going to take off the next quarter or so," Rosmarin said.
Meanwhile, the company's stock has languished. It traded at 1-1/4 Tuesday afternoon, up 1/8, but a long way from its 52-week high of 8-28/32.
"People are losing their patience with our marketing plan," Rosmarin said.
